messages:
Priya (infra): Planning a maintenance window for the 'mistral' GPU pool in us-west2 this Sat 23:00-01:00 UTC. Reason: NIC microcode + small BIOS thermal calibration. We'll do soft reboots and avoid PSU cycles.
Tom (sre): What's the expected capacity delta and approach?
Priya (infra): Expect ~8-15% capacity reduction during peak of the window. Plan: staggered node drains, parallelism=4, cadence ~1 node / 60s per cohort. Use warm spares and prefix cache seeding to reduce cold-starts.
Javier (oncall): 15% is borderline. Do we have warmbackfill seeded in the same AZ? Also need an MTU sanity check post-reboot.
Mei (scheduler): Yes 10 warm GPUs reserved (mistral-warm). Seeding command: `ops/bin/seed-prefix --pool=mistral-warm --keys=popular --threads=6`. Will trigger seeding 90m before window.
Nora (support): We'll notify tenants with Dedicated reservations in us-west2 and any customers pinned to mistral-pool. Draft notice: "Maintenance in us-west2 may cause brief capacity throttling and transient latency 23:00-01:00 UTC. No data loss expected. Reach support if pinned capacity is impacted."
Priya (infra): Add note for enterprise customers: offer temporary burst credits if pinned SLA is affected. Also mention route fallback to eu-west as contingency.
Tom (sre): Canary plan: start with 2 canary nodes, shift 3% traffic for 12m, run health checks: p95 < baseline+40ms, error-rate < 0.7%. If canary breaches, rollback to old microcode image and stop rollout.
Mei (scheduler): Canary encoded in job 'jobs/mistral/soft-reboot-roll.yaml' with canary_count=2, canary_window=12m, ramp_steps=5, max_parallel=4.
Priya (infra): We'll set routing tag to deprioritize nodes with uptime < 4m: `route_hint:avoid_recent_boot=true`. Also set a temporary routing policy to steer latency-sensitive customers to other regions automatically.
Javier (oncall): Paging rule: if available GPUs in region < 5 for >5m, page oncall. Also alert on KV cache miss > 10% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.
Tom (sre): If p95 regresses by >30ms in canary, trigger `tcpdump -i eth+` capture and attach to the incident ticket. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mistral-softcycle. Steps: ack -> pause -> rollback -> rehydrate caches.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "mistral pool maintenance in 24h" posted to #eng-infra and #oncall.
Nora (support): I'll prepare status page and support templates. Ask: should we include expected extra cost?
cost-bot: Estimated incremental ops cost: ~$2.1k (GPU hours + egress + storage IO). Finance approved under maintenance budget.
Priya (infra): Confirm networking team will verify MTU variance < 2% on canary and validate link counters. @networking-team please watch physical link errors.
Mei (scheduler): Rolling timeline: 21:30 UTC seed caches (mistral-warm), 22:30 final smoke, 23:00 canary start, 23:15 evaluate, 23:20 ramp with parallelism=4, finish by 00:50, 01:00 cool-down done.
Javier (oncall): Who's on-call during the window? I'll be standby 22:45-01:15. Tom, can you own rollback gates?
Tom (sre): I'll own rollback gates and healthdash. Will prepare a temporary dashboard with p95, error-rate, KV-miss, MTU-delta.
Nora (support): Draft notice posted to #customer-success-drafts. Please review and approve before publishing to status.redwood.ai.
Priya (infra): Also note: some spot backfill might be throttled during drains; scheduler will prefer reserved capacity. Mei, ensure scheduler flag `prefer_reserved=true` during window.
Mei (scheduler): Set in job: `prefer_reserved=true`, `backfill_threshold=0.1`.
Javier (oncall): Add guard: if cross-region failover > 6% sustained, escalate to infra lead and product.
Tom (sre): We'll also enable short-lived additional telemetry for the window: packet-drop counters, NIC retransmits, and per-node thermal delta.
infra-bot: Deploy job queued: `mistral-soft-reboot-v5` at 6111112222 (dry-run passed).
Priya (infra): Final asks: react :thumbsup: when acked. I'll flip infra-bot reminders to 2h and 15m. Any objections to routing fallback to eu-west?
Mei (scheduler): :thumbsup: Routing fallback OK.
Nora (support): :thumbsup: Will notify pinned customers separately with a backfill plan.
Javier (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll join if canary trips.
Tom (sre): :thumbsup: prepping dashboards and rollback scripts now.
Priya (infra): Thanks all. I'll post the final customer message and runbook link after legal/product review. Anything else?
Javier (oncall): Nothing more. Good luck, team. :coffee:
